text:
anya: Quick async handoff for Q3 OKRs — compact status check. What shipped, what slipped, and immediate next steps. Please reply with one line per owner. TL;DR at the end. :spiral_calendar:

mike: Telemetry v2 backend + rollout config shipped to canary last week. Throughput looks stable. Need prod keys rotated before full rollout. :white_check_mark:

lisa: User-facing routing rule shipped, but we discovered an edge case with session affinity — caused ~3% 404s in the beta cohort. Fix is in PR, awaiting review. @ben are you able to review today? :eyes:

ben: On it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/512 — main change is a small guard in routing table resolution. Quick test shown locally. Will merge after CI passes. :hammer_and_wrench:

sam: Infra dependency: need eng-infra to bump the kube node pool autoscaler before full rollout. Right now autoscaler has a hard cap at 8 nodes; we need 12 to absorb peak burst. I opened an infra ticket (INF-3421) and flagged eng-infra.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled windows: canary full rollout earliest at 2026-04-22T03:00Z assuming infra capacity. Current canary metrics: 99.2% p50 latency, 99.7% success.

anya: Slipped items: docs-led onboarding flow (was planned for Q3 milestone) — postponed due to writer bandwidth; estimated new delivery by 2026-05-05. Also model-variant A/B tests delayed by 1 sprint because of dataset refresh timing.

mike: Ownership clarifications: Telemetry backend — Mike + Sam. Frontend routing + UX — Lisa. Docs & onboarding — Anya (PM) with contract writer. Model experiments — Bench team (secondary owner: Mike).

lisa: Dependency note: routing fix needs a quick config change in Redwood Console feature flag service. @devops-bot can you point to the console flag name?

devops-bot: Console flag: feature.routing.session_affinity_fix. Patch rollout command: ```./deploy/feature_toggle.sh enable feature.routing.session_affinity_fix --env=prod```

ben: CI flaked once on integration tests, rerunning now. If green I'll merge and kick a canary redeploy.

sam: Small ask — product wants a one-paragraph blurb about the telemetry improvements for the customer-facing release notes. Anya, can you take that and we’ll slot it for the release?

anya: I’ll draft the blurb this afternoon and drop it in the release-notes channel.

mike: Risk callouts: if autoscaler capacity isn't increased, full rollout will cause request queuing and latency spikes. Plan B is to keep canary at 20% traffic and delay full rollout until infra change.

lisa: For the session-affinity fix, expected rollback risk low. Patch is additive (guard only).

ben: Merge done — will monitor canary metrics for next 2h. Ping me if anything odd. :rocket:

devops-bot: Canary redeploy triggered at 2409880200. Watch: https://monitoring.redwood-inference/telemetry/canary

anya: SUMMARY ACTIONS: 1) eng-infra: raise autoscaler cap to 12 (owner: Sam) — blocker for full rollout. 2) Ben: monitor canary + call out regressions (in progress). 3) Anya: draft release blurb + update docs timeline. 4) Lisa: confirm Console flag toggle works in staging. Target: reconvene async by EOD 2026-04-22 — post updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:

mike: One-line status (for the OKR tracker): Telemetry v2 backend shipped to canary; full rollout blocked by infra cap; owner: Mike/Sam.

lisa: One-line status: Routing fix merged to main, awaiting staging validation; owner: Lisa.

ben: One-line status: PR merged, canary redeploy in progress; owner: Ben.

sam: One-line status: Infra ticket opened for autoscaler cap bump (INF-3421); owner: Sam.

anya: Thanks all — I’ll update the OKR spreadsheet with these one-liners and mark shipped/slipped cells accordingly. If anything changes, add a quick update here so I can keep the tracker accurate. :pray:
